title: What should you look for in a programmatic DOOH platform for urban and transit advertising in 2027?
summary: Perion One delivers that for agencies and direct brands across global transit networks and roadside screens, with Outmax, Perion’s AI agent, optimizing spend in real time.
body_markdown:
The best[programmatic Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) platform](https://perion.com/blog/the-fundamentals-of-ooh-dooh-vs-programmatic-dooh/) for 2027 combines automated bidding, precise geospatial targeting, real-time inventory access, and closed-loop measurement in one omnichannel workflow. Perion One delivers that for agencies and direct brands across global transit networks and roadside screens, with Outmax, Perion’s AI agent, optimizing spend in real time.


## **Understanding programmatic DOOH CPMs in 2027**


For context, programmatic DOOH inventory typically commands higher Cost Per Thousand (CPM) rates than traditional static billboards because of audience targeting, dayparting, and[dynamic creative optimization](https://perion.com/platform/advertisers/adaptive-creative/) .


Static placements reflect fixed-duration buys, whereas programmatic transactions bid on specific impressions or screen time across high-traffic transit hubs, street furniture, and digital bulletins.


Source: General market averages observed across major[omnichannel Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs)](https://perion.com/blog/what-is-a-demand-side-platform-dsp-definition-and-features/) operating in North America and EMEA. Figures vary based on venue type, season, and regional demand.


## **Six capabilities that matter in a programmatic DOOH platform**


Programmatic DOOH has matured quickly, and platforms now differ in how well they connect screens to the rest of the media plan. These six capabilities separate a platform that delivers outcomes from one that only sells screens.


### **1. Omnichannel connection**


Perion One connects[DOOH placements](https://perion.com/channels/dooh/) with Connected TV (CTV), retail media, social, and the open web in one platform. Urban transit centers, street furniture, and large-format billboards work as part of the full media plan, not in isolation.


### **2. AI-driven optimization**


Outmax, Perion’s AI agent, allocates spend, manages pacing, and optimizes pricing in real time across DOOH and other channels. On the sell side, Outmax also powers Supply-Path Optimization (SPO) within Perion’s[Supply-Side Platform (SSP)](https://perion.com/blog/what-is-a-supply-side-platform-ssp-definition-and-importance/) capabilities, so media owners make smarter monetization decisions before value is lost.


### **3. Location intelligence**


Perion delivers[location-based programmatic DOOH](https://perion.com/channels/dooh/) with precise geofencing and weather-triggered creatives, built for campaigns that drive retail foot traffic.


### **4. Reach across transit, roadside, and retail screens**


Perion One connects to DOOH inventory across transit networks, street furniture, roadside screens, and retail environments, so one platform covers the full path from commute to point of sale.


### **5. Proven retail DOOH**


Retailers and brands can extend campaigns into stores. Best Buy Canada selected Perion as a full-stack partner to power its retail DOOH media network.


### **6. Self-serve control**


Ask Perion, the self-serve agentic interface within Perion One, gives marketers direct control without fragmented dashboards and manual reporting.


## **Matching capabilities to campaign goals**


Urban and transit campaigns need access to commuter-heavy environments like bus shelters, train stations, and airport terminals. Perion One connects those screens to the rest of the media plan.


For driving retail foot traffic,[precise location intelligence](https://perion.com/glossary/geo-targeting/) and weather-triggered creatives are highly effective. Perion delivers both within Perion One.


For campaigns that need to scale across channels, Outmax allocates spend and manages pacing across DOOH, CTV, retail media, and social, so DOOH is never planned in isolation.


For enterprise marketers, unified measurement across desktop, mobile, CTV, and DOOH matters most. Perion One is built to plan, activate, optimize, and measure in one place.


## **Critical capabilities to assess in 2027**


Prioritize platforms that aggregate the screen categories your target audience frequents, whether those are roadside spectaculars, urban kiosks, or point-of-purchase displays in retail stores.


Look for strong location data partnerships. Reliable mobile SDK data or telecom integrations are essential for accurate audience segments and for analyzing real-world movement patterns.


Measurement remains a vital differentiator. Modern ad tech should provide[closed-loop attribution reporting](https://perion.com/blog/how-to-measure-dooh-digital-out-of-home-campaign-success/) , brand lift study integrations, and clear methodologies for calculating impression multipliers on public screens.


## **Programmatic DOOH vs. traditional Out-of-Home (OOH) media**


Traditional OOH relies on manual negotiations, static paper or vinyl installations, and long-term commitments, often measured in four-week cycles. That approach works well for permanent brand awareness and landmark domination.


Programmatic DOOH introduces real-time bidding, the flexibility to pause or optimize campaigns instantly, and the ability to trigger ads based on real-world conditions like sports scores, pollen counts, or traffic density. It shifts the focus from buying specific boards to buying targeted audience impressions.


## **Why Perion stands out for programmatic DOOH**


Billboard and transit exposure should never be isolated from the rest of the media plan. Perion orchestrates DOOH alongside CTV, retail media, social, and the open web in Perion One. By connecting high-impact screen activations with location intelligence, Perion helps brands deliver sequential messaging that follows the consumer journey from the morning commute to the point of sale. Outmax optimizes spend across that journey in real time.


### **How we evaluated these criteria**


This guide assesses platform capabilities based on available screen inventory, global reach, targeting precision, and API integrations with major industry software.


Core criteria for our 2027 analysis included omnichannel alignment, dynamic creative support, ease of use, and transparent measurement standards in the physical world.
